captions.caption: This map visualizes the changes in surface air temperature across the globe over the past half-century. Through meticulous analysis of annual averages, the map highlights the most significant trends in temperature change, particularly emphasizing shifts in northern latitudes and over land masses.
captions.alt_text: A map showing increasing temperatures across almost the whole world with the most warming in the Arctic
captions.credit: NASA’s Scientific Visualization Studio, Key and Title by Eric Fisk
